== Summary ==
[[Ryan Morris]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999), co-host of Radio Free DecipherCon. Crop of the left figure (headphones, thumbs-up) from [[:File:Ryan Morris and Mark Tuttle DecipherCon 1999.gif]]. Decipher's captions name "Ryan Morris and Mark Tuttle" without giving left or right; the left/right identification is Bill Bisco's, confirmed 26 October 2026. Photo: Decipher.
